book.title: Nyovara Wao Yakobus Po Ratoe YAKOBUS

content: Wasanuga ntento ana mine so rai, weamo ama ngkove mewen dai

Animaisye mi mo sivuinye muno ayaowi rausen no wapa yasyin? Ana mo raveti nsene mamo nami so: wabekero ananuge inta rai inda raveano wapa bekere rai. Wapa bekere umaso ntatupami no wasanuga rai tutir.

Wasanuga ntento ana inta rai weramu raunande wasaije ramu weti wapare wapo vatane maubaisy. Wabekero anakotare rai mo wasantutu dave ti wapo rakani, weramu wananto rai ramu weti umba wapayaowi muno wasivuiny. Wapaura inta rai jewen, weye wapo Amisye anajo ramu ti.
Wapo inta ranajo Ai, weramu Po raunande jewen weye wapa sambaya ama bekere ngko dainya muno wapo raveo taune wapa wasananibe bo rai ti.

Weapamo wasanuga ntento anakotaro mine so rai, weti wasaurata irati wanya mo ama anap apaya ti no yara nto nserer! Syare wapo raen: ranivara wabe arakobe mine so rai, omamo mare waponayo Amisye ai. Syo raura intabo akato: are pirati be arakobe mine so rai opamo Amisye apa marova pa.
Weti vemo wapo raura wapare Ayao Amisye so ama ine meweno rai jinya, wemi mare, “Wansanuga mamo Amisye po ranari to, weramu ama bekere manakoe rave.”
Amisye pamo apa kove manakoeve wansai, mo wansanuga ama bekere wato ama vambunine rakivan. Wemi mbewar ti Ayao Amisye mo raura mare:

content.text: yara Po kove raugaje irati vatano manuga mpaaje mansai.”

content: Maisyare omai ti, syare wabeaje Amisye ai muno wamarovave Anakakai Akoe ai, indamu Anakakai Akoe umaso nin kobe wasaora.

Wananta wapararai Amisye ai, indati Amisye de pararai wasai. Vatano wapa ayao kakai no wasai, syare wapo wapa ayao kakai wato ransopi. Vatano wasanuga mbe jirumbe, syare wapo wasanuga ratayao da ngkakavimbe.
Syare wapoyov muno wasanimaumbe weye wapa ayao kakaije ntapekan. Vemo wapugoeno wapa ayao kakaije rai jinya, yara wapoyov. Muno vemo wasananibe rai jinya, yara wasanimaumbe.
Wasanuga mpaaje no Amisye amune rai, indati Po wasaijasea titive.
Vemo wapo vatane maura tantunawi nora

Sya arakove, vemo wapo wasaura tantunawi vambinibe inya. Are nyirati nyo nya arakove inta aura tantunawi rako, nyanaikebe ai nyare apa ana dave ngkove ramu rako, weamo nyo Amisye apa ananyao raura tantunawi to ije. Weye arono nyo nya arakove aura tantunawi, weamo wimbeto Amisye apa ananyao raije jewen, muno mbeare somaisy nyo Apa ananyao so raura tantunawi, nyo rapatimu nyare ama ine meweno rai.

Amisye bo pi po apa ananyao raugaje wansai muno Wepi po wama ana wandave rapatimu rui mi ngkov muno rui mi ngkakai. Opamo apa vambunine no irati Ai indamu Po vatane maugav wakare kove rai muno Po weno kakai rapatimu. Weti vemo vatane inta nyo nya vatane inta apa mangke rapatimu nora. Winya varore ma jewena.
Wamare wamo anakere inta raijar, vemo wansanimari Amisy ai nora

Arakove, weapamo inta wapare, “Unumeso rako sansiman dako, indati reanta no munije inta rai muno wano no naije tume intai wamo anakere raijar inda doije ratande wansai.” Weramu arakove, syare wadanide!
Weapamo wapantatukambe animaisye mirati sansimane pa nande wasai. Weapamo wasaurata irati kijaowe rai, wamerananta wandaeno we saon ti nto ti rakanive vayave.

Weramu wasararin, wakangkamambe wapa ana wapo rave rai. Omamo ngkove ramu. Yara syare wapo raura taiso: “Ranivara Amisye beker ti po kove raugaje reansai, wea indati wamo namije rave muno nami wato rave tavon.”
Ranivara nyo raen animaisye mirati nyo rave indamu mamaisy, weramu nyo rave jewen, omamo ayao kakaije mijem.
